questions.prompt: How should the code be organized for the backtracking approach to Permutations?

choices.label: Only choose later indices after the previous choice.
choices.feedback: That generates combinations instead of every ordering.

choices.label: Keep used indices marked after returning from a branch.
choices.feedback: Sibling branches need those positions available again.

choices.label: Allow an input index to be chosen more than once in a permutation.
choices.feedback: Every original position must appear exactly once.
